title: Adjunctive taurine shows mixed results in first‐episode psychosis

sections.abstract: <jats:p>Twelve weeks of adjunctive treatment with the inhibitory neuromodulatory amino acid taurine improved psychiatric symptomatology but not cognition relative to placebo in young adult patients being treated for first‐episode psychosis, a new study has found. Researchers suggested that these results warrant further investigation of taurine in larger randomized trials.</jats:p>
